title: Weigh the latent cache
hints: Latent bytes are layers times (rank plus rotary width) times byte width — no factor of 2 for K/V, the latent already holds both.
Kimi-K3 counts only its 24 full-attention layers; the 69 KDA layers keep fixed recurrent state instead.
The GQA formula from chapter 6 is the comparison baseline, not the answer for MLA rows.
